name: Intendencia de Montevideo
body: nosniff, framing limited to its origin, a main landmark, and every link opened answered. But all 20 pages read name an http:// canonical on montevideo.gub.uy, a different scheme and host than the live site.
lesson: Point each canonical at the exact https URL you serve, with the www if you use it.
summary: www.montevideo.gub.uy scores 77 out of 100 (C). 1 check fails now, 27 are at risk, and 14 pass. Fix first: 20 pages name another URL as canonical.

fix.title: 20 pages name another URL as canonical
fix.fix: Make each page's canonical point at itself unless it is a real duplicate.

fix.title: 60 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 1 form control has no label
fix.evidence: On /institucional/telefonos. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 20 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /noticias, /institucional/gobierno, /institucional/dependencias and 16 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages read. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 3 cookies are sent without Secure
fix.evidence: Without Secure: dtCookie, TS018b2a8e, TS0167dcca. Set on /, /noticias, /institucional/gobierno and 17 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
The start page declares its language
Core Web Vitals pass for real visitors
